description: Ronin's 5-of-9 validator quorum was effectively centralized: 4 keys held by Sky Mavis plus a 5th delegated from Axie DAO via a never-revoked sign-on-behalf permission. Spear-phishing of a Sky Mavis engineer compromised the 4 in-house keys; the same Sky Mavis RPC infrastructure was used to sign as Axie DAO, reaching quorum. The bridge contract logic is correct; the false invariant was that the 9 signers were independent organizations.
